_comment: Implementation state of each approved work package. States: NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, IMPLEMENTED, TESTED, PARTIAL, BLOCKED, FAILED, NOT_RUN. TESTED means automated tests on synthetic fixtures pass in this repository; it never means independent accuracy or real-sheet validation.

WPU-00.title: Baseline and frozen contract assurance
WPU-00.notes: Package and R1 ZIP hashes verified; snapshot equals local main e676ff1; baseline 334 passed/6 skipped and R1 checker 16 passed recorded. Real Worksheet host COPY not available: G-HOST NOT_RUN.

WPU-01.title: Stage telemetry and zero-extraction health
WPU-01.notes: OCR_DISABLED / OCR_ENGINE_MISSING / OCR_FAILED / OCR_RUNTIME_EXCEPTION / ZERO_WORDS_WITH_INK / PARTIAL_TILE_FAILURE / OCR_WORDS_DROPPED_IN_EXPORT are distinct. The real S025 sheet was not available as a PDF: S025-type behaviour is tested on synthetic scans only.

WPU-02.title: Page and region classification
WPU-02.notes: Encoding classes, title/revision/notes/table/legend/border regions, rotated and CropBox pages, round trip. Heuristic thresholds are development defaults; real-sheet layout accuracy NOT_RUN.

WPU-03.title: Adaptive vector + raster OCR
WPU-03.notes: Orientation/contrast/scale re-reads with provenance, alternatives, bounded presets, per-tile failure counters, missing-engine fallback. Tested with injected word engines; recall gain on real sheets NOT measured. No alternative OCR engine added (RapidOCR unified-package migration not attempted: needs comparative tests, pinned hashes, licence audit).

WPU-04.title: Engineering text, metadata and tables
WPU-04.notes: Quantities with units and pressure basis, sizes/reducers, text classes, ruled-table binding without row crossing, revision history, notes/holds. Station-data style tables on real sheets NOT_RUN.

WPU-05.title: Original-geometry symbols and valve/actuator classification
WPU-05.notes: 6 valve styles, 4 actuator heads, 3 instrument bubbles, 5 equipment shapes; original geometry; classes withheld below score; actuation independent of valve class. Real-sheet recall (S023 valves) NOT measured; filled/curved glyphs of real drawings are not guaranteed to match these shapes. An optional ONNX detector was not added (no licensed model available).

WPU-06.title: Raster detector and dense tiled symbols
WPU-06.notes: Tiled detection with overlap and explicit PARTIAL on caps; scan-style pages (synthetic) give candidates with source coordinates. Real scans NOT_RUN.

WPU-07.title: Vector linework and capacity-aware geometry tiling
WPU-07.notes: 9000-stroke synthetic page is tiled with no lost junction; PARTIAL only when a hard cap is hit. The older topology analyser (20000-stroke refusal) is unchanged.

WPU-08.title: Raster network, junctions and direction
WPU-08.notes: Vector: typed T/crossing/dot/hop/skew junctions and aligned-arrow direction TESTED. Raster: junction dots and arrow heads TESTED. NOT IMPLEMENTED: raster hops, and a raster stroke path graph feeding the typed graph (raster pages get marks but no port-to-port edges).

WPU-09.title: Engineering port/asset graph v2
WPU-09.notes: Typed ports, occurrence vs asset hypotheses, drawn-path edges that stop at the first foreign port, direction from arrows, conflicts, stable hashes: TESTED for vector pages. Raster-page edges and nozzle-level equipment ports NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

WPU-10.title: Instrument loops, controls, protection proposals
WPU-10.notes: Loops only with a drawn signal link; disconnected controller stays LOOP_NUMBER_ONLY; logic NOT_SHOWN_ON_DRAWING; no SIL/IPL fields (guarded). Not an engineering review.

WPU-11.title: Crosssheet and revision reconciliation
WPU-11.notes: Two-source off-page evidence, same-tag never merged, interpretation-vs-source diff, stale reviews, project-level CLI and Tools action. Matching on real multi-sheet projects NOT_RUN.

WPU-12.title: Additive SQLite v13+ and review workflows
WPU-12.notes: v13 additive tables, append-only triggers, automatic backup, interrupted-migration and restore tests, decisions with source hash and model generation. Windows crash-injection beyond unit tests NOT_RUN.

WPU-13.title: Source-linked PySide6 UI and registers
WPU-13.notes: Quality tab, library-symbol overlay and review, AI package export, analysis depth, sheet reconciliation: offscreen tests PASS. NOT IMPLEMENTED: relation (edge) overlay and graph-neighbourhood expansion for the v2 graph, virtualised tables. Manual 175% DPI / keyboard-only review: NOT_RUN.

WPU-14.title: AI export schema and public SDK
WPU-14.notes: Snapshot validates against contracts/engineering_intelligence_v1.schema.json; every narrative claim links existing evidence; package is partitioned, formula-safe, never overwrites; zero-extraction run reports INCOMPLETE. No LLM is bundled or called.

WPU-15.title: DEXPI 2.0.1 validated adapter and format status
WPU-15.notes: BLOCKED: the official DEXPI 2.0.1 XSD is not supplied and no XML-schema validator is installed; export refuses with a specific status and a mapping report is delivered instead. DXF source mode TESTED separately. Licensed CAD (DWG/DGN) adapter not started.

WPU-16.title: Quality benchmarks, annotation and calibration
WPU-16.notes: Tooling and scorer TESTED on toy data. NOT_RUN: any independently annotated real gold, two-annotator adjudication, calibration (no calibration data exists), 30 reserved synthetic drawings (never touched). No accuracy is claimed.

WPU-17.title: Windows security, CPU and batch recovery
WPU-17.notes: Quick/standard/deep presets, no-network guard test, cancel at every stage with consistent resume, hostile-byte and path tests PASS. Existing Job Object memory limits unchanged. NOT_RUN: hostile-PDF fuzz corpus, AppContainer, CPU/RSS measurements on a second machine.

WPU-18.title: Systemwide regression, handoff and installer
WPU-18.notes: Full suite, R1 checker and preflight recorded; SBOM, notices, traceability, ADR and owner checklist written. Installer rebuilt locally and unsigned; clean-machine install NOT_RUN; code signing NOT_IMPLEMENTED; legal review of dependency licences NOT_RUN.

WPU-19.title: Final owner release review and residual blockers
WPU-19.notes: Candidate delivered for owner review. No production approval, no independent engineering review, no host copy test.
